verdict.rationale: stagewise documents diff review and undo/redo for agent code edits. That is an adjacent feature for reviewing and rolling back individual agent actions, not versioning, review, or rollback of automations (saved or recurring workflows). Nothing in the evidence shows a first-class automation object with version history, and SKILL.md files are only instruction files, not versioned automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: Undo — Roll back all changes from a specific agent action.
